notes.title: Performance patch and bug fix
notes.notes:
- Fixed bug where President might be loaded incorrectly when loading save games
- improved performance
- removed WASD movement (was never supposed to be in the game) 
- fixed action popups so they appear more centered above the senators portrait

notes.title: Balancing Patch
notes.notes:
- made AI nations less pacifist, it still takes time for them to build up claims but not  as long
- removed option to set windowed mode because there is a bug with cursor offset that unreal has ignored
- fixed issue with committee portraits not being refreshed after an election
- balancing actions, it won't cause wild swings in support now
- disabling tutorial is permanent now and won't come back when restarting the game

notes.title: patch 2
notes.notes:
- you can now propose war declarations to the senate
- fixed save bug with ghost armies
- fixed bug when banning all parties. Now a new one will be created to compete after the ban
- fixed bugs with new parties being formed. They'll happen less often
- fixed event text bug when loading
- fixed bug with population loading
- fixed bug with laws and events loading incorrectly

notes.title: Quick Patch September 2
notes.notes:
Fixed numerous bugs with saving and loading. 

Event text should now load properly, locations save correctly, and issues with generals loading their party loyalty. I also removed some filtering of international news so that players can see how relations are changing even though there might not be any wars.

notes.title: Playtest Version Released!
notes.notes:
Hi all!

I'm pleased to announce that the playtest version is released and ready for testing. 

Please download the game and give any feedback, suggestions, bugs, etc. 

And remember, this is an early build and some features, like foreign diplomacy, wars, research, isn't in-game yet.

You can give feedback on the Steam forums or by participating in the Discord server.

This is a passion-project for me, and I want it to be fun, so really appreciate anyone who gives it a try!
